extracted.intended_audience: U.S. applicants and practitioners filing PCT international applications via the U.S. Receiving Office (EFS-Web)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and electronically filing a new international patent application under the PCT through the United States Receiving Office (RO/US), including required documents, format requirements, fee payment options, and commonly accompanying transmittals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic filing page size
rubrics_metrics.description: The required page size for a PCT international application filed via EFS-Web in pdf format is A4. See PCT Rule 11.5.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When filing with EFS-Web submit PDF documents sized to A4 to comply with PCT Rule 11.5.

rubrics_metrics.name: PDF resolution requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All pdf documents submitted via EFS-Web must have a minimum resolution of 300 dpi.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all uploaded pdf files are at least 300 dpi to avoid processing issues or rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT-Easy zip composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional documents must not be added to the PCT Easy zip file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When using PCT-Safe Easy mode, include only the expected files in the zip; do not append unrelated additional documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant residency/nationality requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant must be a resident or national of a PCT Contracting State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For RO/US competency at least one applicant must be a resident or national of the United States and the application must be entirely in English. Confirm applicant residency/nationality before filing with RO/US.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language and receiving office competency
rubrics_metrics.description: The application must be entirely in the English language for the United States receiving Office (RO/US) to be deemed competent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If filing through RO/US, prepare and submit the entire application in English; otherwise RO/US may be considered incompetent to act as receiving office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indication of intent to file internationally (PCT Article 11(1)(iii)(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: The application papers must indicate that it is intended as an international application pursuant to PCT Article 11(1)(iii)(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the appropriate options (e.g., radio button in EFS-Web) so the filing is identified as an international application; this selection produces the Electronic Acknowledgment Receipt indicating “International Application for filing in the U.S. receiving office.”

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation of Contracting State(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: At least one Contracting State must be designated pursuant to PCT Article 11(1)(iii)(b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unless otherwise indicated, all Contracting States are designated for any PCT international application having an international filing date on or after April 1, 2004. Ensure designation is present on the Request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum content for international filing date (name, description, claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: The application must contain the name of the applicant, a description, and a claim or claims pursuant to PCT Article 11(1)(iii)(c)-(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To secure an international filing date, include at least these elements in the initial filing; missing items may lead to defects and invitations to correct.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT Request (Form PCT/RO/101) submission formats
rubrics_metrics.description: The PCT Request (Form PCT/RO/101) may be filed via EFS-Web in either (1) conventional PDF format or (2) PCT-Safe Easy (zip) format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conventional: upload the pdf of RO/101 including the last sheet (EFS-Web). PCT-Easy: upload a zip file created with PCT-Safe Easy mode software. Document code categories: PCT Form and PCT Application Part with codes 'RO/101 Request form for new IA conventional' or 'RO/101 Request form for new IA PCT-Easy format'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature not required for filing date
rubrics_metrics.description: The request does not need to be signed in order to obtain an international filing date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the request is unsigned the receiving Office will invite the applicant to correct the defect by sending an invitation to correct; do not assume signature is mandatory to secure the filing date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description / Specification requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The application must include a description (specification).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the Specification as part of the PCT Application Part; use appropriate document code 'Specification'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The application must include claim or claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims are part of the PCT Application Part and should be submitted using the 'Claims' document code.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: An Abstract is part of the international application and, where applicable, must be included with the initial application documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit an Abstract as PCT Application Part under the 'Abstract' document code; ensure it meets PCT abstract conventions where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings requirement and formats (PCT Article 7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Drawings, when necessary for the understanding of the invention pursuant to PCT Article 7, must be provided; black and white line drawings are typical.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'Drawings only black and white line drawings' code for line drawings. Although there is no provision for photographs under the PCT, use the 'Drawings – other than black and white line drawings' code for non-line drawings. Prepare clear black-and-white line drawings where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence listing submission options
rubrics_metrics.description: A sequence listing may be submitted as a single text file which will not be included in the number of sheets of the international application and which will be used for purposes of search, or alternatively submitted in pdf format (which will be included in the number of sheets) but in that case will require a text file of the sequence listing and statement of identity for purposes of search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If submitting as text file, use document code 'Sequence listing (text file)'; if submitting PDF, use 'Sequence listing' and also supply the text file and statement of identity per PCT search requirements. Consider which option best fits your filing and search needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter I fee payment advisory (PTO-2038 caution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Advisory: If filing by EFS-Web, do NOT attach the PTO-2038 form as a PDF along with your EFS-Web submission; this may expose your credit card information via PAIR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To protect payment information, it is recommended to pay fees online using the electronic payment method rather than uploading payment forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter I fee payment methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter I fee payment may be made electronically via the fee payment screens; may be made on the Request fee calculation sheet annex including an authorization to charge a deposit account; or by uploading a document giving authorization to charge a deposit account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document code categories: PCT Application Part and PCT General Transmittal. Use the fee payment screens for immediate electronic payment or include the RO/101 annex with authorization; ensure authorizations are correctly formatted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmittal letter (preferably PTO-1382)
rubrics_metrics.description: A transmittal letter often accompanies a new international application filed under the PCT; preferably use PTO-1382.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a transmittal letter under document code 'PCT General Transmittal and PCT Application Part' with description 'PCT transmittal letter' to help clerical processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee calculation sheet annex (RO/101 Annex)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee calculation sheet annex often accompanies the filing and is used for calculating Chapter I fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the RO/101 Annex (fee calculation sheet) where appropriate and use the document code 'RO/101 Annex (fee calculation sheet)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence listing cover letter and statement under PCT Rule 13ter
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequence listing cover letter and sequence listing statement (under PCT Rule 13ter) often accompany the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use document codes 'Seq Listing Cover Sheet/Stmt under PCT Rule 13ter' for both the cover letter and the statement; include them when submitting sequence listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Power of attorney (including general power of attorney)
rubrics_metrics.description: Power of attorney documents (including a general power of attorney) may accompany the filing and have document code categories PCT Change Request and PCT Application Part.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit power of attorney documents when representation or agent appointment is required, using the proper document code 'Power of attorney'.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT-Easy validation log
rubrics_metrics.description: PCT-Easy validation log often accompanies a PCT-Easy (PCT-Safe Easy) submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the PCT-Easy validation log as part of the General Transmittal and PCT Application Part when using PCT-Easy to facilitate automated validation tracking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to deposited microorganisms / biological material (RO/134)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the invention involves deposited microorganisms or biological material, include the reference using document code RO/134 (Deposited microorganisms/Bio material).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the appropriate deposit reference and document code for biological material to satisfy PCT requirements related to such deposits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for restoration of right of priority (PCT Rule 26bis.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for restoration of right of priority under PCT Rule 26bis.3 should be accompanied by evidence for restoration of the priority claim and are filed under PCT Change Request and PCT Petition document codes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When seeking restoration of priority, include the required evidence and use the 'Evidence for restore of priority claim' document code.

rubrics_metrics.name: Miscellaneous Chapter I communications (rare)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rarely, there may be a Chapter I communication for which no other document code is applicable; use a miscellaneous incoming letter document code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For unusual Chapter I communications not covered by other codes, use 'Misc incoming letter from applicant IA' under PCT General Transmittal and PCT Application Part.
